pilot_disclosure: Five-case seed-24021 exploratory pilot informed selection of threshold 1.15, 11-point median, four confirmations, 16-point cooldown and abrupt-jump >1.5; 150 holdout seeds executed after freeze.
negative_findings: 16 gradual drift cases produced no alerts by the end of 240 observations

method: Frozen median deviation detector with persistence and trailing-20 adjacent-jump classification; 30 seeds per synthetic type from fixed seed formula. No threshold retuning after freeze.
limitations: Pilot-informed parameters so not fully independent methodological design
Synthetic uniform noise magnitude ±0.26 and predefined change types
Single deterministic stream length 240, no arbitrary noise distributions
No causal conclusions about ROOT0 ancestry, RH, NS
